findings.where: Motion sketch panel, the 'REPLAY THE CUT' control; also the article specimen's attachment title 'Streamlining the PPP Process…', which has the same look
findings.fault: The replay control is a button that does something on the page, but it is styled as an underlined text link, the look the article specimen uses for a real link. On this sheet, a bold light underline means both 'go somewhere' and 'do something here'. The tile is meant to set the signifiers that later rounds copy.
findings.who_objects: A visitor who taps an underlined line expecting a new page and gets a replay instead. The layout and animation rounds would also object: they inherit a tile where one look means two functions, and Angélique's articles will carry real underlined links next to it.

findings.where: First screen, the hero section drawing: the amber-hatched third bay sits above the amber 'WRITE TO MARK' button. On phone, both are in the first view.
findings.fault: The amber that marks the one action is also spent on a large piece of decoration, and the decoration sits higher on the screen. So the first amber shape the eye lands on does nothing, and the button is no longer the only thing in the action colour. The palette names amber as 'daylight in the drawing, and the one action', so one colour carries two functions. The direction card asked for this amber band, so this goes back to the brief rather than being a build slip.
findings.who_objects: A development-bank visitor scanning for how to reach Mark. The strongest colour is supposed to point to the one action, and it is split between a hatch they cannot use and the button. That weakens the brief's 'one call to action in view'.

findings.where: Nav bar / title block: the 'DRAWING MMM-GA-001' and 'SCALE NTS' cells next to PROFILE, ARTICLES, BLOG, CONTACT (on desktop they share one row; on phone the title-block cells sit in the same boxed grid directly above the nav row)
findings.fault: The static drawing number and scale sit in boxes ruled exactly like the nav links' boxes, in the same white spaced capitals. The ruled cell means 'navigation' for four cells and 'just a label' for two. Only the small grey caption and the mono face tell them apart.
findings.who_objects: A phone visitor who taps 'MMM-GA-001' expecting a page, because it sits in the nav grid, and gets nothing.

findings.where: Article specimen, the boxed attachment row ('Streamlining the PPP Process…  Lecture · 2026-04-23 · PDF')
findings.fault: The whole row has its own outlined box, so it reads as one tappable card. Only the underlined title acts; the 'PDF' and date side of the box does nothing. The same thin outline also frames the static texture specimen and the motion sketch panel, so a box means 'tappable' in one place and 'just a frame' in others.
findings.who_objects: A reader who taps 'PDF' or the empty right side of the card to open the lecture and nothing happens. That will happen every time Angélique adds a PDF in this form.
